evoverse.description: I develop web-based casino games and internal back-office tools from scratch — around 10 games delivered so far, each in about two weeks including testing and fixes. I build interactive 2D and 3D game interfaces with React Pixi (PixiJS) and Three.js, keep game state in Zustand and server data in TanStack Query, and integrate REST APIs and real-time features. I own each game from first commit to release in a team of 8: 4 frontend developers, 2 backend developers, a designer and a manager.

houseCrm.description: I developed the front end of a production CRM for a real estate business that manages a large property portfolio across the city. I built analytics dashboards with charts, tables and filters that track income and payback for each property and tenant across 15 years of data, plus forms with validation. I worked in a small team under senior developer guidance with an agile workflow and GitHub code reviews; the business uses the system today and the team still maintains it.

about.title: About me
about.description:
Frontend Developer with nearly 2 years of commercial experience building production web applications with React, Next.js and TypeScript.

At an iGaming company I develop web-based casino games and back-office tools from scratch, including 2D and 3D game interfaces with PixiJS and Three.js. Before that I built analytics dashboards for a real estate CRM that the business still uses in production.

I follow Feature-Sliced Design, Clean Architecture and SOLID, test my code with Jest, React Testing Library and Vitest, and use AI developer tools — Cursor, Claude Code and OpenAI Codex — in my daily workflow. I also have basic backend knowledge: REST APIs, WebSockets (Socket.IO), JWT, Node.js and Express.

I'm open to remote work and relocation.

skills.title: My skills
skills.description: Technologies and tools I use to build production web applications.

megaWin.title: Mega Win
megaWin.description: A joint project I built with a colleague during my internship at Evoverse, the company where I work now. Mega Win is a bet platform with roulette, keno, plinko and dice games, a leaderboard and rewards. The repository lives in the company's GitHub organization, but it is a non-commercial learning project, so I can show it publicly. Built with Next.js 16, React 19 and TypeScript on Feature-Sliced Design, with layer boundaries enforced by eslint-plugin-boundaries. Game state lives in Zustand and server data in TanStack Query with Axios and automatic token refresh. Forms use React Hook Form and Zod, the UI is built with Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui and Motion, and the code is covered by Jest and React Testing Library tests with Husky and lint-staged checks.

houseCrm.title: House CRM
houseCrm.description: A commercial team project for real estate management, developed alongside experienced developers. Working within the FSD (Feature-Sliced Design) architecture allowed me to master professional standards for building scalable applications within a monorepo. I was responsible for the frontend implementation using Next.js 16, RTK Query for state management, and TanStack Table for advanced data handling. The system features visual analytics (Recharts) that track income and payback for each property and tenant across 15 years of data, automated PDF documentation, and a modern UI built with Shadcn UI and Framer Motion. The codebase adheres to strict quality standards (ESLint 9, Husky, lint-staged) and is verified with Vitest and Playwright. While I am not the owner, the repository owner (https://github.com/San88Francisco) officially confirms my participation and can provide recommendations. Live preview: https://houses-crm.vercel.app (Login: user@example.com / Password: string).

portfolio.title: Andrii Portfolio
portfolio.description: A personal portfolio website built with Next.js 16, React 19, and TypeScript 5.9. Styled with Tailwind CSS 4, Radix UI, and Framer Motion. Features include internationalization with next-intl, form validation via Zod and React Hook Form, and toast notifications with Sonner. This project demonstrates my ability to build clean, modern, and production-ready applications.

newsReactfy.title: News Reactfy
newsReactfy.description: A feature-rich news application built with React and TypeScript. Users can browse articles, filter by category, search, and switch between light and dark modes. The project uses Redux Toolkit for state management, Axios for API calls, and custom hooks for advanced logic. It demonstrates practical experience in scalable and interactive React applications.

quotesApp.title: Quotes App
quotesApp.description: A quote management application built with Next.js and TypeScript. Users can search, add, edit, and delete quotes through a REST API. The UI is styled with Tailwind CSS and ShadCN UI, with error handling via React Toastify. Unit tests are implemented using Jest, ensuring reliability and maintainability.

getTaskDriver.title: Get Task Driver
getTaskDriver.description: A Trello-like task management app built with React, TypeScript, and Redux. Users can create lists, add tasks, set deadlines, mark completion, and manage multiple boards. The UI uses Material UI and Framer Motion for smooth interactions. Authentication is handled with JWT, with unit tests and Storybook snapshots for quality assurance.

bookLibrary.title: Book Library App
bookLibrary.description: An online book library application with search and filtering functionality. It was first built with classic Redux and later refactored to Redux Toolkit for better structure. The backend is a simple Express server, with Axios handling data requests and Toastify showing notifications. This project demonstrates both legacy and modern state management approaches.

shopStore.title: Shop store
shopStore.description: A collaborative e-commerce jewelry shop built entirely with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The project includes a fully custom shopping cart powered by LocalStorage and responsive UI elements. I contributed to UI implementation, form handling, and planning of app structure. It demonstrates teamwork, GitHub collaboration, and development without frameworks.

homePro.title: Home Pro
homePro.description: A responsive landing page for a home service company designed in Figma. It includes scroll-triggered animations, a content slider, and an accordion component. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, styled using BEM methodology. This project highlights clean responsive layout and interactive UI development.

farmVest.title: Farm Vest
farmVest.description: A responsive landing page showcasing agricultural investment opportunities. It features engaging animations, parallax effects, and a modern UI design. Developed with HTML, CSS, Sass, and JavaScript, styled with BEM methodology. The project demonstrates smooth interactions and attention to visual details.

goCorona.title: GoCorona
goCorona.description: A health awareness landing page with a responsive design and modern layout. It includes animations, smooth navigation, and interactive elements for user engagement. The project was built with HTML, CSS, Sass, and JavaScript, structured with BEM and automated using Gulp. It demonstrates solid knowledge of UI design and frontend fundamentals.

finance.title: Finance
finance.description: A financial services landing page with a professional and minimal UI design. It features responsive layout, smooth navigation, and clean visual presentation. Built with HTML, CSS, Sass, and JavaScript, styled using BEM methodology and designed in Figma. The project emphasizes detail-oriented design and polished frontend delivery.

interia.title: INTERIA
interia.description: A landing page for an interior design studio with a clean, minimal UI. It features a responsive layout, smooth navigation, and a polished visual presentation. Built with HTML, CSS, Sass, and JavaScript, styled using BEM methodology and designed in Figma. The project emphasizes detail-oriented design and careful frontend delivery.
